palette: slate blue-grey tower, coral seal, pine ribbon, mist silver, paper cream, graphite ink
typography: tower-hall headings on slate rail tabs, paper chips and coral wax verdicts
composition: a tower hall where land and house chips travel in lockstep, a condominium board splits three rights with a dependent ribbon, community lanes sort roads greens and parking, a voting ladder climbs double-two-thirds to double-three-quarters, and neighbouring relations fork into three modes
surface: paper files, slate desk rails, mist tags, coral wax seals
motion: land and house chips move as one bound pair through transfer and mortgage gates, the shared-rights ribbon drags behind its exclusive chip wherever it goes, voting chips climb each threshold rung and lock, and blocking walls rise or fall across the three neighbouring modes
transition: the slate hall floor, slate rails and coral seal posts persist while bound pairs, boards, lanes, ladders and forks are re-dressed between scenes
